scientific_integrity: A global exact structural theorem is proved algebraically and supplemented by a finite exact arithmetic replay; no independent external validation or empirical-data guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires homogeneous two-state hidden Markov transitions, c != s, strictly interior probabilities, no false positives, conditional independence, and exact three-season population detection-history law; finite samples and changing transitions are not covered.
title: Exact three-season identification of dynamic occupancy with drifting detection
